- There's also an open task to decide whether to accept the warning or instead respond via the enclosed hearing form (Anhörungsbogen) if you disagree [item:itm_v19vhmndxqbw].

That claim is not in Ordnung's record and should not be trusted — the due date above stands. I'd suggest checking the paper letter itself to confirm it hasn't been tampered with.
